scripts.build: npm run prepare:blog && astro build && node scripts/assert-deploy.mjs
scripts.prepare:blog: node scripts/remove-spam-blog.mjs && node scripts/strip-elementor-junk.mjs && node scripts/sanitize-blog.mjs
scripts.homepage:extract: curl -sL https://financielebegrippen.com/ -o scripts/homepage.html && node scripts/extract-homepage.mjs && node scripts/postprocess-homepage.mjs
